_contract: Each arm's `expr` is a projection over the fixed driver preamble bindings `nixConfig hola lib host channelInput cfg` (see ci/bench/fleet-stats.sh header + ci/bench/MEASUREMENT.md for the full contract). Keys prefixed with `_` are manifest metadata, not arms. The two dedup arms (Task 7) are SELF-CONTAINED — they ignore the preamble `cfg` and getFlake their own pinned inputs (--impure): `class-share` rebuilds cfg with `nc.inputs.den` overridden to den@s2 (feat/s2-pipe-reads 487cc671) and forces the composition witness under it (per-host; its digest MUST equal the baseline-composition digest — a resolution-only optimization cannot move declarations); `rebuild-dedup` builds the gen-rebuild fleet graph (gen-rebuild 7a87691), asserts resultEqualsFullRebuild + coneOnlyRecompute on the REAL corpus, and is fleet-WIDE (fixed editHost, identical for every host binding — run it at ONE host).

class-share.expr: let denS2 = builtins.getFlake "git+file:///home/sini/Documents/repos/den?ref=feat/s2-pipe-reads&rev=487cc671e87982ad04bca69fb9a5723c85ed22ca"; ncS2 = nixConfig // { inputs = nixConfig.inputs // { den = denS2; }; }; cfgS2 = hola.adapter.runDenFleet (l: l) (hola.corpus.denFleet.mk { nixConfig = ncS2; inherit host channelInput; }); in builtins.hashString "sha256" (builtins.toJSON (hola.adapter.compositionNames cfgS2))

rebuild-dedup.expr: let genRebuild = (builtins.getFlake "github:sini/gen-rebuild/7a87691f004679668852d53fc130a57bc305e20a").lib; channelOf = { bitstream = "nixpkgs-unstable"; blade = "nixpkgs-master"; cortex = "nixpkgs-master"; }; hosts = [ "bitstream" "blade" "cortex" ]; compFor = h: hola.adapter.compositionNames (hola.adapter.runDenFleet (l: l) (hola.corpus.denFleet.mk { inherit nixConfig; host = h; channelInput = channelOf.${h}; })); r = hola.adapter.fleetRebuildSoundness { inherit genRebuild compFor hosts; editHost = "bitstream"; }; in if r.resultEqualsFullRebuild && r.coneOnlyRecompute then builtins.hashString "sha256" (builtins.toJSON r) else throw "rebuild-dedup soundness FAILED: ${builtins.toJSON r}"
